sources.title: MS3.2 24B Magnum Diamond model | NanoGPT
sources.snippet: rsLoRA finetune of a text-only conversion of Mistral Small 3.2 24B Instruct (2506), built to bring the Magnum mix's Claude-like prose to a smaller footprint. The "Diamond" moniker nods to the extra heat and pressure - pre-tokenization plus custom loss masking - to turn the assistant-tuned base into creative-writing gems, with or without character names or prefill.

sources.title: MS3.2-24B-Magnum-Diamond: Text-to-Text model — overview, use cases ...
sources.snippet: Overview MS3.2-24B-Magnum-Diamond is a 24-billion parameter text generation model fine-tuned from Mistral-Small-3.2-24B-Instruct-2506 using rsLoRA adapters, created by Doctor-Shotgun. The model targets creative writing and roleplay scenarios by emulating the prose style of Claude 3 Sonnet/Opus models at consumer-friendly scale.
